Lipoprotein particle (LPP) size:  
Pattern B (small, dense LDL-C) is 
associated with increased risk of 
CHD and is responsive to diet.  
Pattern A (larger, buoyant LDL) is 
not associated with risk. LPP are 
not recommended in new ATP4.

Triglycerides 
(TGs)
Lipases release glycerol and fatty 
acids from TGs;
The association of TGs and CHD  
has been shown. Elevated TG  
increases blood viscosity.
,150 mg/dL normal
.500 mg/dL high
Fasting specimen is essential; 
sugar concentrated foods and 
alcohol ingestion can increase 
TG level; some anticoagulants 
may affect TG level; carnitine- 
dependent fatty acids synthesis.
